eps.o: Daniel is unsure about his new babysitter, but he gives it some time and has a tigertastic day.
Daniel and O the Owl sleep over at Katerina’s. O feels uncomfortable at first, but gives it some time and decides to stay.
Daniel feels worried when Mom Tiger hurts her arm, but talking about it helps him feel better.
Jodi loses her stuffie, Benji the Hedgehog, and is worried her mom won't find him. Talking about it with her friends helps her feel better.
Jodi gets frustrated when she can’t do a ballet dance, but she sticks with it even though it is hard.

eps.t: Daniel Tries Something New With Grandpere
eps.o: Daniel struggles to make a snack all by himself, but he keeps trying and gets better at it!
Daniel is excited for his first day at day camp! He and his friends go on a nature walk full of surprises.
Camp Counselor Amira shows Daniel and his friends how to make colorful tie-dye shirts.
On her birthday, Miss Elaina learns it’s important to take time to appreciate gifts from friends.
Then, when Daniel receives a gift from Grandpere, he wants more. Daniel realizes he must stop to appreciate the things he has.
With help from her mom and Dr. Anna, Miss Elaina makes bandages that look like her skin color.
With help from the grown-ups, Chrissie and her friends build a ramp so that Chrissie can climb to the top of the slide, too!

eps.t: Mr. Malik Comes Back to School
eps.o: When the class is feeling excited, Mr. Malik helps them calm down and get ready to meet his pet hermit crab
Daniel and Katerina don't want to stop playing in the snow, but Henrietta helps them stop when it's time to do something else.
Dr. Anna and Baker Aker are getting married, and the whole Neighborhood is helping them celebrate! Daniel has an important job as the ring bearer and learns there are many ways to say “I love you.”

eps.t: Daniel and Miss Elaina's Obstacle Course
eps.o: When Miss Elaina’s dad is busy, she and Daniel play in her obstacle course on their own.
Daniel and O want to put on a magic show for Mom and X the Owl, but they’re busy. Daniel and O perform for a puppet audience instead!
When Grandpere sleeps over at Daniel’s house, Daniel thinks about what Grandpere needs to be comfortable.
Daniel’s friends are having a stuffie tea party. When Daniel doesn’t have a stuffie, Prince Wednesday helps him find one.

eps.t: Daniel Helps Take Care of Margaret
eps.o: Daniel is upset when Dad Tiger can’t pick him up from school, but Nana Platypus helps take care of him.

eps.t: Daniel Goes to the Dinosaur Playground
eps.o: On a class trip, Daniel wants to stay with his mom, but she reminds him that Teacher Harriet is also there to take care of him.

eps.t: Daniel's Important Job at the Market
eps.o: Daniel and Dad help Prince Tuesday at the market.

eps.t: Daniel's Important Job at the Enchanted Garden
eps.o: Daniel is excited to plant flowers, but is upset when he gets the job of weeding. He learns that everyone’s job is important!

eps.t: Everyone Has a Turn at Show and Tell
eps.o: Daniel and his classmates learn how to take turns during Show and Tell.

eps.t: Daniel Takes Turns at the Pool
eps.o: At the Neighborhood pool, Daniel and Miss Elaina take turns playing with the bubble wand. Later, he and Prince Wednesday take turns using a pool noodle.

eps.t: Daniel and Max Ask to Play
eps.o: Daniel and Max see their friends playing, but don't know how to join in.

eps.t: Daniel Asks to Play at the Music Shop
eps.o: O the Owl is worried about joining his friends, but when he asks if he can play too, they say yes!
Daniel has lots of activities he wants to do with Juan Carlos, but Mom reminds him to ask what his guest wants to do.

eps.t: Daniel Shows Juan Carlos the Clock Factory
eps.o: Daniel can't wait to show Juan Carlos the Clock Factory, but he remembers to ask Juan Carlos first.

eps.t: Daniel and Miss Elaina Put Their Things Away
eps.o: When Miss Elaina loses her mitten, her mom teaches her how to put her things away so she can find them again.

eps.t: Daniel and Prince Wednesday Put Their Things Away
eps.o: After Prince Wednesday leaves his comic book outside, he and Daniel learn to put things away where they belong.
Daniel thinks Prince Wednesday wants peppers on his pizza, but learns that friends can like different things.

eps.t: Daniel and Jodi Like Different Things
eps.o: At the beach, Daniel gets upset when Jodi sprays him with a water toy. She learns to ask how others like to play.
When Daniel goes on a walk with his family on an ordinary day, they find all kinds of surprises along the way!
After surprising Jodi with a heart-shaped rock, Daniel and his Dad surprise other neighbors with colorful rock drawings.
